Used to collate batch data.

athena.train.main(cfg: DictConfig)[source]

Main function.

athena.train.solve_puzzles(cfg, model, input_encoder: BaseEncoder, puzzle_file, device, max_puzzles=1000)[source]

Evaluate tactical-puzzle accuracy.

  • The CSV’s FEN is the position before the opponent’s first move.

  • If the model delivers checkmate in one at any point, the puzzle is counted as solved, even when the mating move differs from the reference solution.

  • Otherwise the whole reference sequence must be reproduced.

athena.train.train_athena(cfg)[source]

Main entry point for training.
